tests.name: Agent detail — Skills section + picker modal

actions.value: for (const el of [document.documentElement, document.body, document.querySelector('.app-shell'), document.querySelector('.layout'), document.querySelector('.content'), document.querySelector('.app-main'), document.querySelector('main')]) { if (el) { el.style.height = 'auto'; el.style.maxHeight = 'none'; el.style.minHeight = '0'; el.style.overflow = 'visible'; } } true;

actions.comment: The picker's list was rebuilt as a tile grid: `.skills-picker-list` > `.skill-tiles` > `.skill-tile`. `.skill-row` is gone from the codebase.

tests.expect: Agent detail page shows new 'Skills (procedural)' section with 'Attach skill' CTA. Clicking the button opens a modal listing the installed skills as tiles, each with its slug and a token estimate (the count depends on which skill repos are subscribed).
